主要内容: KENTUCKY BANCSHARES INC, a U.S. based company, announced in its Form 8-K filing dated January 30, 2015, that it expects to mail its quarterly financial information for the fourth quarter of 2014 to its shareholders on or about February 6, 2015. The filing includes a copy of this mailing as Exhibit 99.1. The company also mentioned that the information in the report and the attached exhibit is not deemed filed for purposes of Section 18 of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934 or incorporated by reference in any filing under the Securities Act of 1933, except as expressly set forth. The report also includes a release dated January 30, 2015, of the quarterly financial information as of December 31, 2014. The company warned that the discussion in the report may include forward-looking statements based on management expectations, and actual results could differ materially from these expectations due to various factors such as economic conditions, regulatory changes, monetary and fiscal policies, interest rates, demand for financial services, and the impact of its growth strategy.
